SmartDock is an RFID-based equipment borrowing system operated by the equipment room. This application allows registered borrowers to monitor equipment availability, track their active loans, receive due-date reminders, and request loan extensions. Physical borrowing and returning is performed at the SmartDock tower using your registered RFID card.

You must be a currently enrolled student or authorized personnel to register for a SmartDock account. Creating an account does not automatically grant borrowing privileges. Your account must be reviewed and approved by an administrator. An RFID card must be issued and linked to your account before you can borrow equipment at the tower.

You are responsible for:

• Providing accurate registration information.
• Keeping your login credentials confidential.
• Not sharing your RFID card with another person.
• Reporting a lost or stolen RFID card to the administrator immediately.
• Ensuring your contact information remains up to date.

The RFID card identifies you at the tower. You are accountable for all transactions recorded under your card UID.

• Borrowing is permitted only during configured operating hours.
• The default loan duration is 3 hours from the time of borrowing.
• You may borrow one item at a time unless the administrator configures otherwise.
• Viewing an item as 'Available' in the app does not reserve it. Items are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis at the tower.
• You must return the item to its assigned box. Placing an item in the wrong box does not complete a return.
• An overdue item may restrict your ability to borrow new equipment until it is returned.

If you do not return an item by its due time:

• The item will be marked overdue in the system.
• You will receive an overdue notification.
• The administrator will be alerted.
• Your borrowing privileges may be suspended until the item is returned.
• Late returns are still accepted — return the item as soon as possible.

If you need more time, submit an Extension Request before your due time expires. Extension requests require administrator approval and do not automatically extend your loan.

Your RFID card is issued by the equipment room administrator. It is the physical authentication token that identifies you at the SmartDock tower. You must:

• Keep your card safe and in good condition.
• Not lend your card to any other person.
• Report loss or damage immediately so the card can be deactivated and replaced.

All tower transactions using your card are your responsibility, regardless of who physically presented the card.

You are responsible for the equipment from the moment you remove it from its box until it is returned and confirmed by the SmartDock sensor.

• Handle all equipment with care.
• Do not modify, disassemble, or attempt to repair any equipment.
• Report damage to the administrator on return.
• Lost or damaged equipment may result in replacement charges and account suspension.

The SmartDock sensor detects box occupancy but cannot verify item identity. Returning the correct item to the correct box is your responsibility.

The following may result in account suspension or termination:

• Removing equipment without a valid RFID session.
• Failing to return overdue equipment after administrator contact.
• Sharing your RFID card.
• Attempting to interfere with the SmartDock hardware or software.
• Providing false information during registration.
• Repeated late returns.

Administrators may suspend borrowing privileges, require an in-person meeting, or escalate to institutional disciplinary processes where appropriate.

SmartDock records your borrowing activity to manage equipment accountability. This includes your name, email, RFID card reference, borrow times, due times, and return times.

This data is:
• Visible to authorized equipment room administrators.
• Used only for equipment management and accountability.
• Not shared with external parties outside the institution.

Your borrowing history remains attached to your account for the duration of your registration and institutional record-keeping period.

The equipment room administrator may update these terms to reflect changes in operating policy, equipment availability, or institutional requirements. You will be notified of significant changes through the app. Continued use of SmartDock after notification of changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.\n\nFor questions about these terms, contact the equipment room administrator directly.
